Chapter 1147: Chapter 13 A Palm Strike Sends Flying (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

"How could this newly emerged Great Saint have a slight causal connection with me?" Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint wondered in their hearts.

As Chaos Great Saints, even without doing anything, their influence spreads across various Void Domains. This is especially true for newly ascended Chaos Realm masters like Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint who have reached consummation.

Countless beings have causal connections with them.

In contrast, those peerless Great Saints who have been in the Chaos Realm for countless ages almost never strike recklessly, making their causal relationships more straightforward.

Yet, even though the cause and effect of newly ascended Chaos Great Saints are complex and intricate, forming a connection with a Great Saint of Lin Yuan’s caliber still caused Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint to remain unsure and skeptical.

"Is that person... a Great Saint? Or could he be a Great Saint who can rival Dual Origin Great Saint and others?" Compared to the surrounding astonished Chaos Venerables, Divine Wind Venerable and a few other Venerables were filled with extreme panic.

Other Venerables, when facing a Great Saint of Lin Yuan’s power, were at most frightened, but they had previously interacted with Lin Yuan.

In fact, when Lin Yuan refused their invitation, Divine Wind Venerable had vaguely threatened him.

"Divine Wind, what should we do now?"

The two Chaos Venerables following Divine Wind Venerable immediately communicated telepathically. While Chaos Venerables can protect themselves in front of a Great Saint, unless there is no other choice, they would never dare to offend a Chaos Great Saint.

Especially not a formidable Great Saint like Lin Yuan who can directly contend with Dual Origin Great Saint.

Even if Chaos Venerables have means to preserve their lives, if a Great Saint genuinely decides to target a Venerable, it wouldn’t take personal action—just spreading the word would be enough to make the Chaos Venerable hide forever in darkness, never daring to show their face again.

"Don’t panic, let’s retreat for now."

Divine Wind Venerable was inwardly very anxious, but couldn’t show it. The more critical the moment, the calmer one must be.

...

While many Chaos Venerables were discussing.

Near the Xuanhuang Universe entrance area, Lin Yuan’s collision with the three Great Saints, including Dual Origin Great Saint, was becoming increasingly intense.

Since Lin Yuan was closest to the Xuanhuang Universe entrance, he naturally became the target of Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

Rumble.

The terrifying power clashes caused many aspects of space-time to vanish completely.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan felt an invisible penetrating force, passing through the external universe he controlled, falling on his Chaos Realm defensive artifact, then penetrating his physical form, finally dissipated by the internal universe.

Currently, the internal universe within Lin Yuan far exceeds that of a normal Chaos Great Saint in scale,

the terrifying foundation greatly enhanced Lin Yuan’s defensive capabilities. Even if the external force was horrifying, once it penetrated his body, it would be diluted by the internal universe, leaving not much behind.

"What exactly is this power?"

Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint felt slightly uncomfortable, their attacks penetrating into Lin Yuan’s being, while Lin Yuan’s external universe and Power of Fierce Sun Heaven Creation simultaneously affected them greatly.

The omnipresent universe’s suppressive force, along with the radiance of the Fierce Sun,

gave Dual Origin Great Saint and Black Light Great Saint a headache,

especially the latter, as the vast Power of Fierce Sun seemed to begin twisting and transforming the two Great Saints’ exclusive Chaos evolved power.

"You three are really slippery."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint was most furious,

whether it was Lin Yuan, Dual Origin, or Black Light, they were all using their mastery over space-time,

whether controlling it, distorting it, or destroying it.

But what about Wild Barbarian Great Saint? His methods were much more straightforward, and among the three, felt that he couldn’t exert his strength effectively.

"At this rate, I should be able to enter the Xuanhuang Universe first."

As Lin Yuan and the other three Great Saints fought, they were all moving towards the Xuanhuang Universe entrance.

Even though Lin Yuan was being targeted by Black Light Great Saint and others, as long as he held them off, he was sure to enter the Xuanhuang Universe first.

"Black Light, this newly emerged Great Saint might be an ancient undying from countless ages ago, that’s why we haven’t heard of him."

Dual Origin Great Saint looked coldly and secretly communicated to Black Light Great Saint: "Although we are all vying for treasures within this Postnatal Universe, but you and I are Great Saints of similar eras, we must not let this ancient undying snatch the most precious treasures."

"What do you mean?"

Black Light Great Saint’s heart stirred.

"You and I join forces; we absolutely can’t let him enter the universe first." Dual Origin Great Saint said.

Although they were already working together to target Lin Yuan, they kept colliding with each other. What Dual Origin Great Saint meant by joining forces was to completely stop their previous collisions and fully deal with Lin Yuan.

"Go on."

Black Light Great Saint transmitted.

"I have a killer move, definitely able to hold him back, but the premise is no interference."

Dual Origin Great Saint replied.

"You mean you want me to handle him, and not strike at you?"

Black Light Great Saint glanced at Dual Origin Great Saint, after pondering for a moment, "No problem."

According to the current situation, unless something unexpected happens, Lin Yuan will definitely be the first to enter the universe.

As for the second to enter, it is likely between him and Dual Origin.

Meaning, Black Light Great Saint would enter the universe second or third.

And according to Dual Origin Great Saint’s intention, given the time and opportunity, he would thoroughly delay Lin Yuan, making him or Dual Origin the first to enter the universe.

Whereas Black Light Great Saint would guarantee entering the universe second.

Compared to being guaranteed third entry, Dual Origin Great Saint’s proposal obviously aligns more with Black Light Great Saint’s own interests.

"Then I’ll start preparing."

Dual Origin Great Saint immediately closed his eyes, the surrounding space-time suddenly filled with blue and gray hues.

Whoosh.

The Black Light Domain suddenly expanded, trying to envelop Lin Yuan, but was blocked by the external universe.

"Dual Origin Great Saint he..."

Lin Yuan, at the forefront, seemed to sense something and glanced backward.

He could feel that Dual Origin Great Saint had stopped striking him, yet the chaotic space-time around the Chaos Great Saint made it hard to discern what was happening temporarily.

A short while later.

Just as Lin Yuan was incredibly close to the Xuanhuang Universe entrance.

Buzz!

An inexplicable aura quickly approached.

Lin Yuan’s expression changed, he glanced behind him.

At this point, the space-time around Dual Origin Great Saint clarified again.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan noticed the two blue-gray horns on Dual Origin Great Saint’s head, felt his mind and will being attacked, and began to fall.

"Not good."

Lin Yuan immediately realized something was wrong, the internal universe’s power rapidly spreading throughout his body, instantly dispelling the effect.

"Hahaha, you all conceded."

At this moment, Dual Origin Great Saint transformed into a ray of blue-gray light, bypassing Lin Yuan at an inconceivable speed, and surged into the Xuanhuang Universe first.

"You?"

Lin Yuan looked towards Black Light Great Saint, immediately deducing that the two Great Saints must have fully teamed up, otherwise, during the chaotic time around Dual Origin Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint had full ability to intervene and interrupt.

"That Dual Origin, didn’t he say he could delay?"

Black Light Great Saint’s face was displeased, Dual Origin Great Saint indeed held up Lin Yuan, but for how long? In such a brief moment, Dual Origin Great Saint was the first to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, and what about himself?

Rumble.

Lin Yuan, looking at Black Light Great Saint, unleashed a powerful wave of suppressive force and Power of Fierce Sun from the external universe, enveloping Black Light Great Saint completely.

"This?"

Black Light Great Saint’s complexion changed slightly, immediately activating the Black Light Domain to resist.

However, the suppressive force of space-time and the shining light of the Fierce Sun were clearly superior, making it evidently challenging for Black Light Great Saint.

"This ancient undying, was he not exerting his full strength just now?" Black Light Great Saint frowned, feeling the pressure as he faced Lin Yuan alone.

Boom.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, delivering a fierce strike toward Black Light Great Saint.

The blow felt like heaven and earth collapsing, Black Light Great Saint immediately felt an incomparable impact penetrating his whole being, with the Black Light Domain protecting him like an iron ball, then under this impact, Black Light Great Saint along with the Black Light Domain was sent flying far away.

Wild Barbarian Great Saint at the farthest back rejoiced at this sight; with Lin Yuan’s strike, Black Light Great Saint immediately fell behind him.

Swoosh!

After striking Black Light Great Saint away, Lin Yuan didn’t even look, directly stepping into the Xuanhuang Universe.
